description: Build exemption_expirer.py daemon per spec Appendix A. Nightly check scans mcp_exemptions for records past valid_until. Updates status to 'EXPIRED' via write_service :8772. Query pattern: SELECT id, valid_until FROM mcp_exemptions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_until < NOW(). Heartbeat every 60s. Graceful shutdown handling. No direct DB access.
